3. [RARC.14.3] **No event is dropped.** The engine hands every event to the
   integrator before the call that produced it returns, and keeps none past
   that return ([RARC.5.8.7]), so it has no buffer to overflow. A sink slower
   than the engine slows the engine: mid-pump under synchronous delivery,
   between calls under a returned effect list.
